name: SteamcacheDNS
description: SteamcacheDNS provides DNS entries for *.cs.steampowered.com and other download URLs to be used in conjunction with a GenericCache server Please see https://squishedmooo.com/?p=1 for install instructions! You will need them!

variables.name: USE_GENERIC_CACHE
variables.description: Must be set to true to use generic cache

variables.name: DISABLE_FRONTIER
variables.description: Set to true to disable frontier caching

variables.name: DISABLE_ORIGIN
variables.description: Set to true to disable origin caching

variables.name: DISABLE_RIOT
variables.description: Set to true to disable riot caching

variables.name: DISABLE_STEAM
variables.description: Set to true to disable steam caching

variables.name: DISABLE_UPLAY
variables.description: Set to true to disable uplay caching

variables.name: DISABLE_BLIZZARD
variables.description: Set to true to disable blizzard caching

variables.name: DISABLE_WINDOWS
variables.description: Set to true to disable windows update caching
